Overview

Sioux Falls is a city in SD with a population of 192,517. No state income tax, booming economy, and the falls of the Big Sioux River. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials.
